claims.statement: The 2023 protocol already conditions a GNW offset response on conscious detection, while its operational analyses also treat onset/offset as tested expectations. Naccache et al. later argue that attended offset and continuing awareness were not established, that macroscopic PFC decoding may miss mixed selectivity, and that silent storage is not obligatory GNWT.

claims.statement: The Nature supplement contains contemporaneous consortium interpretation (§11), IIT replies by Boly, Koch and Tononi (§12), and a GNWT reply by Dehaene (§13). The IIT authors acknowledge absent sustained synchrony and offer coverage, frequency and ROI explanations; their posterior-sufficiency claim is an interpretation, not an inactivation result. The consortium says shared successful predictions do not uniquely confirm either theory and treats failures as challenges to theories or implementations.
limitations: These contemporaneous statements are not a later consortium rebuttal to the October 2025 Naccache commentary. No exact later consortium or standalone IIT reply was identified in the bounded forward searches; absence is not proved. This is one article/sample, not three independent experiments.

claims.statement: Naccache et al.’s page-2 decoding paragraph includes category among allegedly absent PFC decodings, while the Nature results report transient PFC category decoding. This local wording problem does not answer the separate orientation, duration or measurement-scale objections.

arguments.name: Agreed biological tests and conditional theory defense
arguments.position: Retain the tests as challenges, while distinguishing auxiliary assumptions from full-theory refutation.
premises: The selected protocol fixes operational predictions and the final paper reports failures on some of them.
Antecedent conditional wording about conscious offset detection exists in the published protocol.
Proponents dispute awareness/attention, measurement scale and coverage; those disputes are not new independent data.
bridge_principles: Failure of a predicted measurement challenges the conjunction of theory, auxiliary implementation and measurement conditions.
A successful prediction shared by alternatives does not uniquely confirm one theory.
arguments.conclusion: Preserve a consequential but conditional empirical challenge; neither a whole-theory winner nor automatic dismissal is warranted.
arguments.strongest_objection: Auxiliary-condition defenses can insulate a theory against agreed failed tests; the collaboration was explicitly negotiated to avoid that flexibility.
arguments.strongest_reply: The offset condition predates results publication, and the papers acknowledge measurement and implementation limits; nevertheless source attribution alone does not show that any proposed explanation accounts for the observed failures.
unresolved_issues: Actual attention/continuous awareness at relevant times
How much each implementation is motivated by its core theory
No later consortium rebuttal identified under bounded search

arguments.name: Document chronology and compliance are separate questions
arguments.position: Narrow the v1 methods gap without certifying preregistration compliance.
premises: The December 2022 exact file states the thirds split and unsplit iEEG.
The February 2023 protocol contains different published half-split wording; its exact earlier wording/version timing has not been verified.
The 2025 supplement explicitly records deviations and inconsistent counts.
bridge_principles: Publication order is not necessarily protocol amendment order.
A public file version and hash establish document provenance more directly than actual analyst behavior.
arguments.conclusion: Qualify the historical wording; retain unresolved full history and execution audit, and label exploratory analyses correctly.
arguments.strongest_objection: An internally inconsistent ordinary OSF node is insufficient evidence for a clean prospective analysis history.
arguments.strongest_reply: Agreed; the limited finding is the dated exact document and stated methods, not clean compliance. The matching 2024 copy does not erase the 2022 version record.
unresolved_issues: Earlier amendment chain and actual data-access/code execution history were not audited
No earlier dated half-split original was reopened; different publication wording does not establish a change during the February 2023–April 2025 publication interval.

arguments.name: Do not substitute easier denominators
premises: Per-run volumes and overlapping windows differ from experimental runs or animals.
PET session/subframe totals differ from interview counts.
Selected appendix tables did not resolve the targeted numerator gaps.
bridge_principles: An evidential rate requires the corresponding numerator, denominator and sampling unit.
Repeated or overlapping observations do not by themselves increase the number of independent subjects.
arguments.conclusion: Retain scoped causal/association constraints while withholding reconstructed rates, precision upgrades and population generalizations.
arguments.strongest_objection: Raw files or another appendix may contain the missing totals, so bounded non-recovery is not a source-level absence proof.
arguments.strongest_reply: The packet explicitly preserves that distinction and requests the exact missing table/data fields rather than inventing the counts.
unresolved_issues: Exact interview integer numerators/denominators and repeated-interview mapping
